title: Opening Tutankhamun's Tomb After 3,000 Years
description: November 1922: a candle, a small hole and 'wonderful things'.

scenes.narration: For more than three thousand years, nobody had seen inside this room.
scenes.image_prompt: dark sealed ancient Egyptian tomb chamber filled with golden objects, a beam of light entering

scenes.narration: It's November 1922, in Egypt's Valley of the Kings. Howard Carter has found a hidden staircase.
scenes.image_prompt: archaeologist in 1920s clothing and Egyptian workers uncovering stone steps in desert rock, Valley of the Kings

scenes.narration: His sponsor, Lord Carnarvon, rushes over from England to see it.
scenes.image_prompt: English aristocrat in 1920s suit arriving on horseback in the Egyptian desert valley

scenes.narration: Carter makes a small hole in a sealed doorway and holds up a candle.
scenes.image_prompt: archaeologist holding a candle up to a small hole in a plastered tomb doorway, faces lit by flame

scenes.narration: Asked if he can see anything, he answers: yes, wonderful things.
scenes.image_prompt: candlelight revealing golden statues, couches and chests piled inside a tomb, glinting gold

scenes.narration: Gold everywhere. Chariots, statues, thrones, and couches shaped like animals.
scenes.image_prompt: golden ancient Egyptian throne and gilded animal-shaped couches in a tomb, dramatic light

scenes.narration: Deeper inside lies the boy king himself, wearing a solid gold mask.
scenes.image_prompt: golden funerary mask of an ancient Egyptian pharaoh in a stone sarcophagus, soft lamp light

scenes.narration: Over five thousand objects came out of one small tomb. Which treasure would you want to see? Tell me.
scenes.image_prompt: Valley of the Kings at sunset, tomb entrances in the cliffs
